concern: (low) The mockup uses generic FIN_TECH archetype indicators and placeholder imagery ('assets/images/knowledge-base-crie-hero.webp') instead of dedicated CRIE epidemiological/educational domain assets.
jtbd: When I access the CRIE institutional knowledge base, I want the visual identity, archetype indicators, and media assets to authentically reflect epidemiological research and postgraduate medical education, so that I perceive the system as a specialized, authoritative scientific tool rather than a generic financial dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the approved mockup interface, When examining the hero section badge, typography context, and media preview card, Then all archetype tokens display institutional epidemiological markers (e.g. EPIDEMIOLOGY_EDU / FBUN CRIE) and the media asset references dedicated epidemiological or normative educational imagery with appropriate semantic alt text.
editInstruction: In mockup.html, replace the archetype indicator 'FIN_TECH' with 'EPIDEMIOLOGY_EDU', update the hero logo alt attribute from 'FinTech Brand Logo' to 'FBUN CRIE Knowledge Base Logo', update the hero preview image alt from 'FinTech Main Interface Preview' to 'FBUN CRIE Epidemiological & Educational Knowledge Base Preview', and replace the archetype dropdown option 'FinTech' with 'Epidemiology & Education (FBUN CRIE)' while preserving layout dimensions and WCAG AAA contrast ratios.

concern: (low) Form controls rely on standard dropdown selection without typeahead or search filtering for extensive knowledge base catalogs.
jtbd: When I configure or query catalog parameters across extensive multi-specialty registries, I want form select controls to support typeahead or searchable text filtering, so that I can quickly locate specific codes or disciplines without scanning long unstructured option lists.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a form control managing catalog disciplines or archetypes, When the list contains multiple catalog options, Then the control provides keyboard-accessible typeahead filtering and accessible listbox options compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation.
editInstruction: In mockup.html inside #form-heading section, enhance the select element #project-archetype-select or replace it with a combobox pattern (input with role='combobox' and associated listbox datalist or dropdown container) providing typeahead search filtering and aria-expanded state while maintaining full keyboard focus ring indicators.
